attempts.error_code: Independent shutdown watchdog exited before readiness.

interpretation: The database initialized, but the PostgreSQL concurrency tests did not execute. No PostgreSQL acceptance result is claimed.

Attempt one exited before tests during storage growth; main shutdown was verified but independent receipt retention failed. The early watchdog failure path was subsequently fixed and covered by a portable regression.
Attempt two reached test discovery but timed out connecting from Windows to the loopback-published database on the internal Docker network. Both shutdown paths were verified.
The conservative whole-stage disk baseline is 74.97 GiB, rounded upward from the earlier 74.96 GiB reading. It is not a byte-exact pre-download measurement.

Host free-space changes include other machine activity. Docker image size, database volume size and Windows paging allocation do not establish their respective contributions without baseline measurements.
No network isolation was relaxed and no additional launch beyond the single approved retry was attempted.
next_action: Prepare an offline test runner on the same internal network, with pinned existing base images, reviewed dependencies and a separate launch approval.

post_shutdown_observation.interpretation: Host free space recovered without cleanup. Windows paging allocation declined from 6616 MiB to 3329 MiB; this explains part of the observed change, without proving what originally caused that allocation.
